title: AusMT Survey Metadata 0.1-draft: canonical public metadata for one survey dataset/release
description: DRAFT (0.x): the canonical public metadata representation of one survey dataset/release, generated from the private curation source of truth. Open-world: absence of an optional property means no assertion; new properties never use null. Every property describes the DATASET/RELEASE unless its description names another entity. Frozen only when the freeze gates in AUSMT-SURVEY-METADATA-SCOPE.md pass.

scheme.description: lightly-controlled extensible token: DOI, ROR, Handle, URL, RAiD, local are recognised with format validation; unknown schemes are permitted

identifier.description: the identifier in canonical form; DOIs bare (10.x/...), never https://doi.org/-prefixed

identifier_row.description: one generic identifier assertion; what it identifies is fixed by the property that carries it

subject_row.description: SHARED DEFINITION: byte-equivalent with mtcat's subject_row; one thematic subject as controlled/labelled/resolvable concept

relation.description: DataCite relationType, read 'this dataset <relation> that record'; chosen case-by-case for the true relation

relationship_core.description: SHARED CLEAN CORE with mtcat relationship rows; MTCAT's legacy extensions (custodian/identifies/resolution) are deliberately NOT part of this schema

orcid.description: person rows; omitted when none - never null

version.description: version of THIS schema the document conforms to (0.x while draft); never the dataset version

survey_id.description: the cross-layer joining identifier, identical with mtcat's surveys[].survey_id and station.json's survey_id

dataset_version.description: the DATASET/RELEASE version: Case A = the represented source release's version (never incremented by metadata or representation work); Case B = the AusMT release's version. Never a schema or package version.

issued.description: publication/release date of the dataset/release (ISO date, at known precision); NEVER inferred from acquisition coverage; absent when unknown

identifiers.description: identifiers OF this dataset/release per its Case A/B identity classification; the curated PRIMARY dataset identifier among these anchors citation and the mtcat doi projection

activities.description: related research activities (plural by design; never 1:1 with the dataset); the mtcat raid scalar projects only when exactly one activity row exists

abstract.description: full dataset description, uncapped; the concise discovery text is mtcat's concern

creators.description: citation authors of the dataset/release per the creators policy (source citation authorship wins; institutional creators where the source credits the institution; AusMT never a creator). ORDER IS CITATION ORDER and is preserved verbatim.

primary_custodian.description: present-true on exactly one custodial row where curated; the deterministic source of mtcat's organisation projection

organisations.description: role-typed organisations; publisher is explicit because structured citation generation fails closed without it (and a publisher is never inferred)

funders.description: DataCite-aligned funding; a name-only row is valid (award detail absent = not asserted, never inferred)

preferred_identifier.description: INVARIANT: scheme+identifier MUST exactly match the designated primary entry in identifiers[] (emitter-side semantic validation; JSON Schema cannot express it)

reason.description: why this additional citation is required or recommended, e.g. derived_product, repository_product, required_source_credit, companion_release

citation.description: citation preference/guidance over the identifier set - never a duplicate bibliographic record; a dataset without a DOI remains citable

type.description: optional category, e.g. required_source, custodian, community, traditional_owners, field_support, infrastructure, access_provider

acknowledgements.description: plural acknowledgements, permanently distinct from citation; policy-gated like every assertion

access.description: well-known values open, metadata_only, embargoed; not enum-pinned, unknown tokens fail closed at serve time

bbox.description: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) decimal degrees, same CRS rule as MTCAT

relationships.description: typed links to source releases, collections, archives, reports; the clean shared core only - identifier entity scope is verified in curation, never inferred from resolution proximity

statement.description: reproduced VERBATIM where the upstream licence prescribes wording

changes_made.description: provenance of representation; NEVER an identity classifier or DOI trigger

generated.description: UTC timestamp this document was generated (document provenance, not dataset dates)

provenance.description: presence rule applies: no library or template default is ever serialised as a source assertion
